body:
Good morning, Bakersfield. It’s Friday, August 21, 2026, and we’re starting the day with a high of 101° and air quality at 108 — unhealthy for sensitive groups. Overnight, a semi truck fully engulfed on northbound I-5 south of Grapevine became the night’s longest-running incident, with crews still working the Tejon fire after 6 a.m. and traffic backing up to the Lebec service route. Let’s get you caught up on the night, the news, and the week ahead.

## The Kern Overnight

The night’s most significant incident was a semi truck and trailer fully engulfed on northbound I-5 south of Grapevine. Just before 1 a.m., CHP and Engine 56 were on scene with command established as the Tejon Incident. The fire burned for hours: by 6 a.m. crews were still working it, a heavy-duty tow had been called in, and traffic was backing up to the Lebec service route. Earlier in the evening, around 10:34 p.m., a quarter-acre brush fire on McCombs Road (State Route 43 north of Wasco) was burning with a fast rate of spread and potential to run west. Multiple engines and a water tender responded, additional wildland equipment was ordered, and crews split into Division Bravo and Division Yankee for what command described as a lengthy mop-up. In north Bakersfield, just after 3 a.m., two subjects were on a Woodford Boulevard property behind a white pickup, possibly taking items. The subjects were known to be in possession of firearms, though none were visible at first; officers later made contact and located a firearm. Around 9:50 p.m., a robbery at gunpoint was reported on Denise Avenue in north Bakersfield. The suspect was described as a transient white male in his late 30s, wearing a baseball cap and black face mask, pulling a wagon, and accompanied by a white female. Finally, around 4:36 a.m., three subjects at a trucking yard south of Gibson Street were reported possibly taking items. Deputies set a perimeter and the subjects ran — one headed south toward a fence with an officer holding the hole. One subject was described as known to carry a knife.

## Today's weather

Today’s high will be near 101°, with a low around 74° tonight. It’s currently 100° at Meadows Field (KBFL). There are no active weather alerts for Kern County at this time. Air quality is 108 — unhealthy for sensitive groups. No active fires are reported in the county.

## Top stories

**KGET 17 reports that** Avenal city officials are turning to Arvin as legal issues continue to unfold in the city. The station said the move comes as Avenal faces ongoing legal challenges that have impacted city operations. **23ABC tells us that** the California Highway Patrol has confirmed new details in the deadly Highway 99 crash from early Sunday morning. CHP confirmed the BMW involved in the crash was the vehicle traveling northbound in the southbound lanes at the time of the collision. Initial reports indicated the Honda Accord was at fault. All other aspects of the crash remain under investigation, including potential charges. **KGET 17 also said that** Bakersfield police are seeking the public’s help identifying suspects in a White Lane burglary. The station reported that police have released images of the suspects and are asking anyone with information to come forward.

## Something good

Flood Ministries is celebrating its 20th anniversary of providing assistance to Kern County families. The organization has been dedicated to helping local families find hope and stability over the past two decades. It’s a heartening reminder of the good work happening in our community.

## Coming up this week

This week, there are several events and meetings worth noting. On Tuesday, August 26, a Special City Council Meeting is set for 12:00 p.m., followed by a City Council Meeting at 3:30 p.m. and another at 5:15 p.m. On the entertainment front, Los Yonic's Zamacona, Los caminantes, y Grupo Yndio will perform at the Fox Theater on Saturday, August 23. The Fox Theater will also host Cults & Classics: Season Pass 2026-2027 on Monday, August 25, Rodney Carrington on Thursday, August 28, CUMBIATRON: THE CUMBIA RAVE on Friday, August 29, and Willie Barcena on Saturday, August 30. Additionally, a Michael Return Of The King Tribute Featuring Michael Phoenix is scheduled for Saturday, August 30. Be sure to check the details and plan accordingly.
